toegepas.rede_vinder: For inanimate things 'daarvan' is the idiomatic form, and it stops 'hulle' meaning two different things (the scrolls, then the men) in one sentence.
toegepas.fout: 'hulle' is used twice in one sentence for two different things (the scrolls, then the men's object), so a reader can stumble over who bought whom.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Twee daarvan' is the idiomatic form for things and leaves the second 'hulle' as the only pronoun, with the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Jaar gelede' is the standard written form; 'jaar terug' is colloquial.
toegepas.fout: 'jaar terug' is colloquial, and 'terug gekoop' can be misread as 'teruggekoop' (bought back).
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'jaar gelede' is the standard written form and removes the misreading without changing the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Die kanale dra bloed, lug en ander soorte vloeistof
toegepas.na: Die kanale dra bloed, ander soorte vloeistof en lug
toegepas.rede_vinder: As written, 'lug en ander soorte vloeistof' calls air a liquid; moving 'lug' to the end keeps the same three items without that implication.
toegepas.fout: 'lug en ander soorte vloeistof' implies that air is a kind of liquid.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Reordering keeps exactly the same three items and removes the false implication, without touching the protected 'het geglo' sentence.

toegepas.voor: Vir hulle het dit sin gemaak
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Sin maak' is a calque of 'make sense'; 'sinvol wees' is the standard Afrikaans form.
toegepas.fout: 'sin maak' is a calque of English 'make sense'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Vir hulle was dit sinvol' is the standard Afrikaans form with the same meaning, and the 'want' clause still follows naturally.

laat_vaar.voor: dele van die liggaam kan raak
laat_vaar.na: dele van die liggaam kan beïnvloed
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Raak' can be read as 'touch'; 'beïnvloed' says plainly that the damage affects other parts.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'raak' in the sense of 'affect' is natural, plain Afrikaans here; 'beinvloed' is a heavier word for Grade 5 and only reads differently.

na_skrywer.voor: Wanneer 'n dokter uitvind watter siekte of besering iemand het
na_skrywer.na: 'n Dokter se besluit oor watter siekte of besering iemand het
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: A noun is defined as a 'when'-clause (English pattern); a noun phrase defines it properly and matches the lesson body, where the doctor makes a diagnosis and says what is wrong.
na_skrywer.fout: The noun 'diagnose' is defined with a 'wanneer' clause, an English pattern for a definition.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition, which only the writer may change, and the proposal also moves the meaning from finding out to deciding, so the fault needs a different fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
